description: The Multifunctional Office Executive is responsible for maintaining office premises and facilities, supervising housekeeping staff, and ensuring operational readiness. The role involves procurement and vendor management, maintaining stationery and records, coordinating mail and communication, and organizing meetings and staff travel. The individual works with digital tools, follows organizational policies, ensures customer satisfaction, and adheres to health, safety, and security procedures.
